newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castorseed off lows, groundnut steady.
newsitem.headline: Indian castorseed off lows, groundnut steady.

text.p: Castorseed June delivery initially dropped from 1,175/1,176 rupees to 1,168/1,169 rupees per quintal on slow overseas buying but later bounced back to 1,171/1,172 rupees on light short covering, floor sources said.
A drop in arrivals helped reverse early losses.
Arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region dropped today to 30,000/35,000 bags (75 kg each) from 50,000/55,000 bags reported on Thursday.
One operator said the market was technically oversold.

Groundnut oil was steady at 358/359 rupees per 10 kg amid shortages of ready stock but delivery for next week was available at a lower price of 355/356 rupees per 10 kg as traders were expecting higher supplies next week following the end of a 10-day strike by truckers earlier this week.
"Imported palm oil was steady at 285 rupees per 10 kg but sentiment was subdued on expectation of fresh arrivals next week," one broker said.

"About 2,500/3,000 tonnes of the imported palm oil is held up at Bombay port during the recent strike by the truckers and this oil will come again in the market as truckers have withdrawn their strike," he said.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil was steady at 540/545 rupees per 10 kg.
